title: EOS Machine
description: Knowledge Entity and Aggregate Root identifying one physical manufacturing or inspection unit, not a model or capability.

id.description: Stable identity of one physical machine, not its name, model, location or external identifier.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the serialization contract, not the unit.

recordVersion.description: Version of the record, not the model.

createdAt.description: Record creation timestamp, not manufacture date.

createdBy.description: Creator of the record, not manufacturer.

updatedAt.description: Record update timestamp, not last service.

updatedBy.description: Editor of the record, not owner.

sourceLinks.description: Evidence for the identity and root definition, not for every embedded claim.

changeSummary.description: Summary of the record change, not a maintenance event.

name.description: Non-unique human-readable label, not a serial number or identity.

description.description: Boundary of the individual physical unit, not its configuration or capability.

properties.description: Sourced specification claims applicable to this unit, not measurements, capabilities, commands or operation settings.

classifications.description: Category assignments, not proof of suitability for a process.

notes.description: Optional remarks, not a substitute for deferred structured fields.
